changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: alter table project add column if not exists termination_date date;
alter table project_audit add column if not exists termination_date date;
update project set termination_date = make_date(termination_year, 12, 31) where termination_year is not null and termination_date is null;
alter table project drop column if exists termination_year;
alter table project_audit drop column if exists termination_year;

rollback.sql: alter table project add column if not exists termination_year integer;
alter table project_audit add column if not exists termination_year integer;
update project set termination_year = extract(year from termination_date)::integer where termination_date is not null and termination_year is null;
alter table project drop column if exists termination_date;
alter table project_audit drop column if exists termination_date;
